VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: WIT

The requirements trace (WIT) directly addresses each acceptance criterion and confirms that criterion (C), structured audit logging, is absent. The CI log (ATT) shows tests pass but cannot prove the criterion is met—tests may not cover audit logging. The self-report (SELF) is unverified and contradicted by the higher-admissibility witness evidence. Since all three criteria are required and (C) is missing, the work does not satisfy the acceptance criteria.
